Plants from the south rarely take root in the north. That's why the cornus, once wild and lush in the south, wither and dry here. Though it lacks southern vitality, it still clings to life, drawing breath from the earth. As medicine, it helps ease chill and cold, yet it cannot cure Zhu Yu, who had been poisoned by the Ephemeral Blight. Zhu knew she was doomed.

Only those bold enough to defy the heavens can become the one, eternal River Master. When the dike broke, and the river roared unchecked, Zhu felt that fearless spirit stir within her. The Ephemeral Blight that withered her bones also kindled a fleeting yet fierce power. And in the thunder of Zhu's unwavering cry, the Dragon Hall's battle song rose once more:

"So many souls on this earth, oh hey, but peace remains lost—
The Yellow River flows on, oh hey, as the world pays the cost—"

That was Zhu's final song.

Those who practice it must cast themselves into the darkest depths of Naraka, bearing the weight of karma alone—Infernal Twinblades that cut through sin's weight, purging karma with every strike to guide lost souls to bliss.
